dimensions.assessment: Affects federal regulators at FERC and entities involved in hydropower licensing applications.
dimensions.evidence: the Commission shall submit to Congress a report on the status of... each application for a renewed hydropower dam license.

dimensions.assessment: Administrative reporting requirement regarding existing application statuses.
dimensions.evidence: require the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to annually submit to Congress a report

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or revenue changes are stated or implied.
Amends the Federal Power Act to add an annual reporting mandate for specific licensing processes.
dimensions.evidence: The Federal Power Act is amended by inserting after section 36... the following: SEC. 37. ANNUAL LICENSING STATUS REPORT.
Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this section, and annually thereafter, the Commission shall submit to Congress a report

importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to submit annual reports to Congress on the status of ongoing hydropower relicensing applications.
